window: 1995-2024, calendar-year total returns in USD (annual); private equity from published estimates

sources.source: S&P 500 total return index (S&P Dow Jones Indices, Yahoo Finance ^SP500TR daily closes as mirrored in github.com/alm0421/alm0421 data/prices/^SP500TR.csv); identical to the SPX TR column of the Bloomberg monthly file in github.com/itsthecai/Enhanced-Gerber data/prcs.csv for 1995-2020
sources.note: Calendar years 1995-2024, annual total returns from year-end index levels.

sources.source: MSCI EAFE net total return USD: Bloomberg M1EA monthly levels (github.com/itsthecai/Enhanced-Gerber data/prcs.csv) for 1995-2020; MSCI EAFE Index (USD) factsheet annual net returns (msci.com/documents/10199/822e3d18-16fb-4d23-9295-11bc9e07b8ba) for 2021-2024
sources.note: Calendar years 1995-2024, annual. Net (after withholding tax) returns.

Bloomberg US Treasury Index total return (LUATTRUU), Bloomberg terminal export mirrored in github.com/taka9999/Regime_switching_model_to_fixed_income data/luattruu.csv
sources.note: Calendar years 1995-2024, annual from year-end levels.

sources.source: Bloomberg US Corporate (investment grade) Index total return (LUACTRUU), Bloomberg export mirrored in github.com/taka9999/Regime_switching_model_to_fixed_income data/luactruu.csv

sources.source: Bloomberg US Corporate High Yield Index total return (LF98TRUU), Bloomberg export mirrored in github.com/taka9999/Regime_switching_model_to_fixed_income data/lf98truu.csv (matches the LF98TRUU column of the Enhanced-Gerber file)
sources.note: Calendar years 1995-2024, annual from year-end levels.

sources.source: Published estimates, not a computed series: return from the Cambridge Associates US Private Equity Index 25-year pooled net IRR to 30 Jun 2024 (12.7%, CA benchmark statistics); desmoothed volatility 16.3% (reported 9.5%) and desmoothed correlation 0.80 with public equities from T. Rowe Price, Panariello and Priestley, "A Closer Look at the Diversification Potential of Private Assets" (March 2024, quarterly data Jun 2005 - Jun 2023, unsmoothed with optimal lag lengths)
sources.note: No annual CA series was obtainable here. Arithmetic return = 12.7% IRR + half the reported variance. Correlations with the other classes are 0.80 x the US-equity correlation (one-factor assumption).

sources.source: NCREIF Property Index (NPI) total return: ncreif.org property-index returns table (1978-2010 annual values as transcribed in github.com/puppetjoy/portfolio portfolio0.m; 2011-2024 from NCREIF quarterly tables and NCREIF/industry releases, see tools/frontier-research.md)
sources.note: Calendar years 1995-2024, annual. Geltner-desmoothed (first order, rho = annual lag-1 autocorrelation of the NPI) before computing volatility and correlations; return is the arithmetic mean of the reported NPI. FTSE Nareit All Equity REITs used as a cross-check only.

sources.source: HFRI Fund Weighted Composite Index (HFR): monthly returns from an HFR index download mirrored in github.com/digital-hub-insights/dh-labs-public (1990-2023), compounded to calendar years; 2024 = +9.8% from HFR full-year release (hfr.com, 24 Jan 2025)
sources.note: Calendar years 1995-2024, annual. Not desmoothed (annual lag-1 autocorrelation reported in the notes).
